description: This file declares functions related to prepacking quantized embedding bag weights in the at::native namespace for PyTorch, specifically for byte quantization.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_byte_prepack_out
methods.description: Prepares an output tensor for quantized embedding bag prepacking with optional row-wise Min/Max parameter.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_byte_prepack
methods.description: Returns a prepacked tensor suitable for quantized embedding bag operations.

methods.name: qembeddingbag_byte_prepack_meta
methods.description: Provides metadata for the byte quantized embedding bag prepacking process.
